evidence.text: B3LYP geometry/frequency validation followed by 18-singlet TD-PBE0 and molecular orbitals at the TD level with IEFPCM acetonitrile.

dOMeHeptZ electronic transitions, including weak S1 and bright S2/S3 in the visible interval.

evidence.text: HOMO is core-nitrogen localized for dF/dCl/dMe but peripheral for dOMe; LUMO is distributed across the molecule. Weak visible transition assignments distinguish dOMe from the other three.
